item.title: 【Unreleased/Unofficial (lossy)】MP3 - [REQ AUD] Eminem & D12 live at Glasgow Green, UK (08.25.2001)
item.description: I have been looking for a recording of this show for the past couple weeks and I haven't many leads. To my knowledge only a recording of this show exists in MP3 and a video does not exist unless it is an unreleased pro-shot. I want this show because there was a rare performance of Shit Can Happen which he only had performed 4 times ever, it would also complete a collection of mine, in August 2001 Eminem and D12 had a 4-night run in the UK and this is the last one I need. I know a few traders who have a copy of it but either they're inactive or I have nothing on their wanted list. Searched Soulseek, YouTube, VK.com, Epro, various torrent finder sites, guitars101, sectioneighty, made a request on Reddit a few days ago but no helpful replies yet. Any help is appreciated, thank you!
